scope: Real modules in fictional browser DOM; explicit source URL parameter, not installed or live-site acceptance

checks.name: complete posting retains first and final sections and exact conditions
hidden and application content stay outside captured text
conditions beside an application link are kept while the control is excluded
closed conditions hold the read; expansion preserves their text
selected exact role matches and a different role is refused
a changed application target invalidates unchanged description text
a hidden duplicate is not used
missing title or application proof is held
hidden complete body cannot become a header-only verdict
unexpected layout is held rather than taking its first section
application page and catalogue URL cannot use advert capture
Lever-looking markup on an unrelated site is not sufficient
oversize text is rejected without a partial result
original job cards use title links, not Apply or location text
generic nested and conflicting descriptions retain existing guards
